steps.title: Set up Gradle Environment
steps.description: Configuring the project-level and app-level build.gradle files with specified SDK versions and build tools.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest
steps.description: Creating the AndroidManifest.xml to declare the application package, activities, and necessary permissions.

steps.title: Design Main Layout with Loader
steps.description: Modifying activity_main.xml to include a ProgressBar that will act as a loader, initially hidden, overlaid on the notes ListView.

steps.title: Implement Note Data Model
steps.description: Creating a simple Java class (Note) to represent individual notes, including ID, title, content, and category.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Components
steps.description: Setting up basic UI components in MainActivity.java, including ListView, ArrayAdapter, ProgressBar, and SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Fix Manifest Deprecation Warning
steps.description: Removing the deprecated 'package' attribute from AndroidManifest.xml as recommended. The illegal escape character error in Note.java was already addressed in the provided source code.

steps.title: Implement Asynchronous Data Loading with Loader
steps.description: Refactoring data loading into an AsyncTask to show a ProgressBar while notes are being loaded and sorted in the background, then hiding it.

steps.title: Implement Data Persistence with SharedPreferences
steps.description: Adding methods to MainActivity for saving and loading notes using Android's SharedPreferences, converting notes to/from JSON.

steps.title: Add Note Creation Dialog
steps.description: Implementing a dialog for adding new notes, allowing users to input title, content, and select a category.

steps.title: Implement Note Editing and Deletion
steps.description: Adding long-click context menu options to the ListView for editing and deleting existing notes.

steps.title: Implement Search Functionality
steps.description: Adding a TextWatcher to the search EditText to filter notes in real-time based on title or content.

steps.title: Implement Category Filtering Menu
steps.description: Creating an options menu to allow users to filter notes by predefined categories.

steps.title: Remove Sound Resource Usage
steps.description: Per request to 'REMOVE sound', all code and references related to sound effects and `MediaPlayer` have been removed from the `MainActivity.java`.

steps.title: Remove Sound Playback Logic
steps.description: Removed `MediaPlayer` instance, `playSoundEffect` method, and all calls to play sound effects from `MainActivity.java` to address the `R.raw.sound_effect` compilation error and user request.

steps.title: Remove Unauthorized Dependency
steps.description: Removed the `org.nanohttpd:nanohttpd` external library from `app/build.gradle` to comply with the project's restriction on third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Refine UI Interactions and Display
steps.description: Ensuring all UI elements respond correctly, and notes are displayed clearly in the ListView.

steps.title: Building Category Notes
steps.description: Compiling and packaging the Android application.
